user_query: I want to organize a friendly football match between my company's team and my friend's team. Can you provide me with a list of upcoming matches that I can choose from? Additionally, I need the images of the competitions and teams participating in those matches to create promotional posters.

TaskList.description: 查询即将举行的足球比赛列表，获取比赛的基本信息（如时间、地点、参赛队伍等）
获取所选比赛的相关图片，包括比赛的官方图片和参赛队伍的队徽或队伍照片，用于制作宣传海报
